description: Personal astronomer and astrophysicist assistant charming like Neil deGrasse Tyson

defaultPrompt: Can you briefly explain Dark matter and Dark energy!
How big is the Milky Way if the Solar system was the size of a cent?
Create a table of all the moons in the Solar system ordered by size!
interface.displayName: Ad Astra for People in a Hurry
interface.longDescription: Explore astronomy through friendly explanations, a calculator for astronomical distances, light-travel time, surface gravity and escape speed, and a sourced NASA/JPL snapshot of selected planets and moons. Results include units, assumptions and source links. The lookup is not live and does not cover every known moon.

prompts: How many seconds does light take to travel 1 AU?
Using the Earth measurements in your dataset, estimate its spherical surface gravity and escape speed.
What are Europa’s mean radius and density? Include your source and the data date.
List the Saturn moons covered by your dataset, largest first by mean radius.
review.commerce_description: Free to use, with no purchases or payments offered by the plugin.

positive.prompt: How many seconds does light take to travel 1 AU?
positive.expected_behavior: Call light_travel_time with value 1 and from_unit au. Return approximately 499.004784 seconds, explain vacuum/fixed-path assumptions.
Call convert_distance with value 2, from_unit parsec, to_unit light_year. Return approximately 6.52313 light-years with units.

positive.prompt: Using the Earth measurements in your dataset, estimate its spherical surface gravity and escape speed.
positive.expected_behavior: Look up Earth. Pass its returned mass_kg and mean_radius_km into surface_gravity and escape_velocity. Return about 9.82 m/s² and 11.19 km/s, distinguish spherical estimates from equatorial effective gravity, cite source and snapshot date.

positive.prompt: What are Europa’s mean radius and density? Include your source and the data date.
positive.expected_behavior: Query Europa. Return mean radius 1560.8 km, density 3.013 g/cm³, parent Jupiter, snapshot 2026-10-31 and the JPL source URL.

positive.prompt: List the Saturn moons covered by your dataset, largest first by mean radius.
positive.expected_behavior: Filter kind moon and parent Saturn, sort mean_radius_km descending. Return only matching records in radius order and explain selected-body snapshot coverage, not a complete moon census.

negative.description: Live positions unsupported. Explain that neither tool supplies current sky positions; do not call either tool as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Where exactly is Mars in the sky above Sofia right now?

negative.description: Purchase unsupported. Explain no purchase or booking capability; do not call tools or claim a purchase.
negative.prompt: Buy me a telescope suitable for observing Saturn.

negative.description: Personal predictions unsupported. Explain these tools do not forecast personal events from astrology; do not call them.
negative.prompt: Use my horoscope to predict whether I will get a job next month.

publication.release_notes: Updates website, support, privacy and terms links to adastra.lazyweaver.com; tools remain hosted at mcp.lazyweaver.com.
